sentences: I am going to anyway,'' as all of you know, especially when she rose to be the Appropriations Committee chair.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RELIABLE FEDERAL INFRASTRUCTURE ACT
statements.title: RELIABLE FEDERAL INFRASTRUCTURE ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of the Reliable Federal Infrastructure Act, led by my colleague Representative Langworthy.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to vote ``yes'' on the Reliable Federal Infrastructure Act.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: HOMEOWNER ENERGY FREEDOM ACT
statements.title: HOMEOWNER ENERGY FREEDOM ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, our Nation is facing a housing affordability crisis.
When I was growing up, the median age of a first-time home buyer was 29 years old.
Specifically, they imposed costly climate change codes, restricting which appliances families can use to cook their food and heat their homes.
Instead of improving housing affordability, the Federal Government is burying the dream of homeownership under 6 feet of red tape.
Americans are calling on Congress to improve housing affordability.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of my legislation, the Homeowner Energy Freedom Act.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to vote ``yes'' on the Homeowner Energy Freedom Act.
